regulator: Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation

data_source.name: IDFPR: Illinois adult use cannabis monthly sales figures (PDF, updated Oct 7, 2026)
data_source.notes: Adult-use sales only (in-state plus out-of-state residents); medical cannabis sales are not included in this report, so medical and total are left null. IDFPR notes that from June 2025 sales come from the Metrc track-and-trace system, which records prices after discounts; earlier months included some pre-discount prices, so the drop in mid-2025 is partly a reporting change. Annual figures are IDFPR's own TOTALS rows.

tax_note: Adult-use purchases carry a cannabis purchaser excise tax of 10% (adjusted THC of 35% or less), 25% (THC above 35%) or 20% (infused products), plus state and local sales taxes (Illinois Department of Revenue).
summary: Illinois is one of the largest adult-use markets in the Midwest, second only to Michigan by reported sales. Dispensaries sold $118.6 million of adult-use cannabis in September 2026, and $1.05 billion in the first nine months of 2026. Reported sales peaked at $1.72 billion in 2024. The $1.51 billion reported for 2025 is not directly comparable, because the state's switch to Metrc in mid-2025 began capturing prices after discounts. Visitors from neighboring states without legal stores have long been a large share of buyers, so newer markets in Missouri and Ohio, plus price compression, weigh on growth. Item counts, by contrast, keep rising.

faq.q: How much cannabis does Illinois sell a month?
faq.a: Illinois dispensaries reported $118.6 million in adult-use sales in September 2026, according to IDFPR. Monthly sales in 2026 have ranged from about $105 million to $126 million.

faq.q: Why did Illinois cannabis sales drop in 2025?
faq.a: Part of the drop is a measurement change. IDFPR says the Metrc tracking system, fully in place by June 2025, records actual prices after discounts, while earlier data partly captured pre-discount prices. Item counts stayed steady.

faq.q: Do the Illinois figures include medical cannabis?
faq.a: No. IDFPR's monthly report covers adult-use sales only, split between Illinois residents and out-of-state visitors.

faq.q: How much do out-of-state visitors spend on cannabis in Illinois?
faq.a: Out-of-state residents bought $206.9 million of adult-use cannabis in January through September 2026, about a fifth of the total, per IDFPR.
